about: Measured noise at public permanent monitors, for checking the modeled map. Positions are estimated from the airport's monitor maps (not published as coordinates).

Van Nuys.notes: 2025 = energy average of the published daily CNELs (one decimal); official annual values are rounded. Aircraft only: VNY publishes no total/community CNEL.

Sepulveda Transit Corridor.notes: Appendix O (HTA): 24-hour hourly Leq per site, read by OCR; day/evening/night Leq and CNEL computed from the hourly values (Ldn matches the report within 0.2 dB except site 19). Positions geocoded from addresses (Census), roughly 30-80 m.

Los Angeles International.notes: Official calendar-2025 annual CNEL (whole dB). Positions from the public WebTrak monitor list, checked against the georeferenced map (10-20 m).

Long Beach.notes: 2025 = day-weighted energy average of the monthly average-daily aircraft CNEL (not an official annual value). Positions from WebTrak (2020).

Santa Monica.notes: Calendar-2025 aircraft CNEL, Table 3-1 (HMMH). Positions from WebTrak.

Burbank.notes: Calendar-2025 aircraft CNEL (Table 4); monitor coordinates from Table A-1. The 4Q 2025 table used arithmetic, not energy, means (reads up to 0.4 dB low annually; site 6 more).
